source: Fleeting weekly discovery crawl whole-board history (board_source.py)
methodology: A window is a comeback only when the board history shows all four: it is on this week's board, it was absent from the immediately-preceding bundle, an earlier bundle carried a genuinely-passed close date (so it really closed - board absence alone is never read as a closure), and its current listing is forward-looking. We claim only that its last run ended on closed_on and it is back now. No guessed comebacks; a missing current end date is 'ongoing', not invented.

items.title: Pop-Up Bar at the Terrace
items.blurb: Weekend-only pop-up bar on the Riverfront Park terrace. Three sessions across Friday through Sunday; different hours each day.

items.title: Don't Look Ethel: A Salute to Ray Stevens
items.blurb: Packed all-star bill with Jamey Johnson, Ronnie Milsap, Lee Greenwood, Ricky Skaggs, Gretchen Wilson, and others honoring Ray Stevens's catalog. Single night at the Opry House.

items.title: An Evening With Jim Messina
items.blurb: One-night solo performance from the Loggins & Messina co-founder in downtown Franklin. Single show, no supporting details given.

items.title: Trunk or Treat at Breeden's Orchard Apple Celebration
items.blurb: Trunk or treat tied to the seasonal apple celebration at this Mt. Juliet orchard. One-day fall harvest event.

items.title: Spice Heaven Grand Opening Week
items.blurb: Grand opening week for Spice Heaven at Nashville Farmers Market, open daily through Saturday. Long hours make it easy to slot in.

items.title: Boo at the Zoo
items.blurb: Presented by Middle Tennessee Honda Dealers, the Zoo's annual Halloween event runs through the first weekend of November.

items.title: Impractical Magic at Hidden Bar
items.blurb: Follow the candlelight behind a storage door at Noelle to reach Hidden Bar, where the cocktail menu runs to midnight margaritas and love spells themed around the Owens family home, no reservations needed.

items.title: Fear Fest! at Franklin Theatre
items.blurb: A packed Halloween weekend of ticketed screenings including Ghostbusters, Hocus Pocus, Psycho midnight show, and a 2026 Backrooms film. Multiple time slots each day.

items.title: Candlelight: Tribute to The Beatles
items.blurb: Beatles catalog on strings at the Conrad. From $36.

items.title: Cheekwood Harvest
items.blurb: Cheekwood's 55-acre botanical garden runs its harvest festival through November 1, featuring 100,000 pumpkins, a new Marigold River, and evening Harvest NIGHTS. Adults $21-$29, seniors $19-$27, students $17-$25.
